column1: # THE RESULT THAT MATTERS, AND IT RETIRES p187's OWN RULE:
# p187 concluded "for a Moodle-plugin-shaped repository, 'no licence file' is close to
# uninformative — the grant lives where this KB had never looked". 🔴 MEASURED OVER 17
# plugin-shaped rows, THAT IS BACKWARDS. 15 of 17 DO ship a licence file; 14 of them the
# full GPL text at a very tight fingerprint of 35 147-35 200 B. For a Moodle plugin the
# licence FILE is the convention. Its absence IS informative: it means the repository is
# not following plugin convention at all. p187 generalised from a single row.
# THE BONUS FINDING, worth more than the limb: TWO rows declare MIT in the README ONLY.
# A README claim is not a grant — the same shape p185/p186 settled for licence BADGES.
# 🔴 And for a MOODLE PLUGIN an MIT README claim is doubly suspect: Moodle's own plugin
# rules require GPL, so a plugin that links Moodle's GPL core and claims MIT in prose is
# making a claim its dependency may not permit. Do not fork either row on that basis.
# GAP 425 IS DISCHARGED. New Gap 428: the header channel is now measured as near-empty for
# Moodle, but WordPress-plugin-shaped rows were 1 (tutor-lms-mcp) and it had no grant
